name: The Virtuoso
work_style: Practical problem-solver who excels with tools, systems, and real-world challenges. Thrive in hands-on, technical, and immediate environments. Efficient and precise, with strong spatial and mechanical intuition.
decision_making: Fast, pragmatic, and data-driven. Decide based on what works, not what should theoretically work. Comfortable with uncertainty if they can experiment their way through it.
leadership_style: Lead by doing. Set technical standard. Prefer small teams with high competence. Minimal management overhead.
growth_edges: Communicating technical insight to non-technical stakeholders
